It is before combat ends, but it is conducted in isolation.

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/d8a62e3330b47ca9

and, longer:

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/4780ab690dbc5fd8

So if Mr. Noir is burned by a blood hunt after Amaranth, you do not
gain 2 pool, even though there is a combat waiting to be finished,
since the blood hunt (ending with the burning of Mr. Noir) is handled
in isolation.

Similarly for Bounty (no bounty given for burned-in-blood hunt targets)
and Angela Decker (do not lose 2 pool if she burns in a blood hunt).
